messages:
mike: Heads up — we have a staged rollout scheduled tonight 23:00 UTC (EU first). Goal: runtime v2.3.1 with kernel perf fixes. Need a short statuspage snippet and an email blurb for customers. deploy-bot will post canary at 22:30.

deploy-bot: Canary job scheduled: runtime-canary-eu @ 22:30 UTC. Will post result back to thread. :robot_face:

anya: I'll draft both. initial statuspage snippet below — short and factual, we can tweak:

```
Scheduled maintenance: runtime v2.3.1 rollout
Start: 23:00 UTC (EU), Staged rollout across regions
Expected impact: brief request retries or elevated latency for a subset of Dedicated customers during the window. Hosted customers: minimal disruption.
Mitigation: automatic regional fallback and canary gating. No data loss expected.
Updates: will post at start, mid-window, and on completion.
```

sophie: Add one line about pinned versions: "If you have pinned a specific runtime version, you may see the pin persist — contact support to schedule a coordinated update." Keeps it explicit for Dedicated clients.

jamie: Also call out enterprise support contact for managed upgrades. Suggest: "Enterprise customers: your CSM will reach out if you are on an SLA contract and require coordination."

mike: Good. For the statuspage blurb I'll combine those. Need a short subject for the email: suggestions?

anya: Subject suggestion: "Planned maintenance: Redwood runtime update (v2.3.1) — action may be required if you pin versions"

sophie: Email body snippet (short):

```
Hi —
We will perform a staged rollout of runtime v2.3.1 on DATE at 23:00 UTC (EU first). You may experience brief retries or latency spikes during the window. If you have pinned to a specific runtime version, contact support or your CSM to schedule a coordinated upgrade. We'll post updates to our status page at start, mid-window, and on completion.
Thanks,
Redwood Support
```

mike: Nice. Plan for comms cadence: statuspage at T-2m (pre), T+30m (mid), and T+N (complete). Who is owning live replies? @sophie? :eyes:

sophie: I'll own live replies and triage customer messages during the window. I'll escalate to eng-oncall for any regressions.

deploy-bot: Canary ran at 22:34 UTC — result: PASS. Proceeding to staged rollout across EU nodes. Logs: `canary-pass: true`.

mike: Great — publishing statuspage pre-window at 22:58 UTC and queuing the customer email batch for accounts with >$X spend. We'll send lower-priority batch after completion.

jamie: I'll ping the top 10 enterprise accounts directly with a heads-up (pinned versions flagged). Also note: include rollback contact method in the email (eng-oncall slack channel + support ticket link).

anya: Small wording tweak to statuspage: change "brief request retries" -> "intermittent request retries for a small percentage of requests" — more precise.

mike: Done. Final statuspage snippet and email body posted to the status page draft. eng-oncall, please standby for 23:00 UTC. If we need a rollback, revert traffic to runtime v2.3.0 and notify support channel.

eng-oncall: Roger that. On standby and watching metrics dashboards. Will comment in-thread if we trigger rollback.

sophie: Thanks team — I'll open the outbound email at 22:59 and watch responses. :thumbsup:

mike: Closing this prep thread. Will update when pre-window post goes live."
